cooling-rate-slopes.alt: The graph of T = 20 + 70e^(−0.05t) for t from 0 to 60 minutes falls from 90 °C toward the dashed room-temperature line at 20 °C. Tangent segments at T = 90, 55 and 30 have slopes −3.5, −1.75 and −0.5 °C per minute, each equal to −0.05 times (T − 20).
